cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: The Conspiracy Expands
cards.instruction: Use every denial, coincidence, and missing detail as proof that more people and higher stakes are involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Our toaster receipt is gone. The shop must have someone inside this house. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I probably recycled it. We can get a copy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. So the recycling crew removes originals while the shop prints replacements.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Every shop? Then it's the whole high street. We can't trust a single warranty.

mechanism: A directs a receipt search and accommodates B replacement-copy solution while treating ordinary recycling and retail practice as a growing conspiracy.
confusable: Unlike testing a hypothesis, every benign explanation adds alleged participants and threatened warranties.
comparison: Household receipt anxiety differs from a station leader imagining a coordinated employment plot.
